edges.subject: CLN3
edges.quote: CLN3 (ceroid lipofuscinosis, neuronal 3), an endolysosomal protein that is linked to Batten disease, as an evolutionarily conserved protein that facilitates lysosomal chloride efflux.

edges.subject: lysosomal dysfunction
edges.quote: How lysosomal dysfunction contributes to neurodegenerative diseases is an important open question.

edges.subject: TFEB
edges.quote: These findings provide new insight into the role of CLN3 in lysosomal ion homeostasis and raise the possibility that modulation of the TFEB-CLN3 signaling axis may hold therapeutic potential for lysosomal storage disorders.
